HOWEVER, the class is not based on percentages so if you miss more than 15 points you cannot get an A. My percentage grade is an 86, but in the class I will end up with a C. Complete garbage.

Don't save them for last minute either, its a good 3-4 nights of reading articles before quiz, but easy 100. Only lost 3 points all semester.
